facts.description: Kaif UI is an open-source component library designed to help developers create stunning, accessible, and customizable user interfaces. It provides ready-to-use components, blocks, and templates built with modern technologies like Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, and ShadCN UI.
